hints.title: Displacement Equivalence
hints.text: Removing a window of length k changes the final coordinate by subtracting that window's net displacement.

hints.title: Sliding Vector Window
hints.text: Maintain the net delta (dx, dy) of the k-length window as it slides along the string.

hints.title: Distinct Coordinates Count
hints.text: Insert each unique window displacement into a hash set and return its size.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of move string s
complexity.notes: Sliding window tracking net displacement vectors in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating the entire movement path from scratch for each window takes O(N * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set stores up to N distinct coordinate pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that subtracting window displacement preserves final coordinate uniqueness.
